caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass bottle with a long narrow neck and a bulbous base, rendered in shades of blue and teal. The bottle’s surface is adorned with rows of evenly spaced oval or circular raised dots that cover its bulbous lower section and extend partway up the neck. The color application emphasizes a smooth and glossy texture with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest light reflection and a transparent or translucent quality. The bottle is centered on a plain, off-white background, enclosed within a rectangular border, and the overall composition is simple with no additional objects present in the image.
title: Bottle
